Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.

Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability

Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Accurized Rounds

This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.desc:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Light Touch
perks.desc: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Trickle Charge
perks.desc: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Featherweight
perks.desc: Final blows with weapons that have the Featherweight Origin Trait grant increased movement speed while equipped.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Snipehunt Mk.47 is a lightweight auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, there's the opportunity for double damage perks with Jolting Feedback in the first trait perk column applying Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage. In the second column, for straight damage, you can pair that with Gear Shift which stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or Chaos Reshaped which stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. For additional arc splash damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~27 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Tex Balanced Stock origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - this procs a refreshable, mainly PvP focused buff after hitting 4 hip-fire shots within 4s of each other, which boosts Range, Handling and Reload Speed by +20 with a ×0.9 animation scalar, +1.5° Hip-fire precision angle threshold, better ADS speed, but also for PvE grants +35% stagger force. There's also the E-Tier Featherweight which stacks up to ×10 to improve movement speed. If you're interested, the name references a practical joke where beginners are led into the wilderness on a fabricated mission to hunt a non-existent bird. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
